title: Size bound for the exactly-three Tseitin transformation
statement: Let $\psi$ be a finite CNF formula, and let $w$ be a natural number with $3\le w$ such that every clause of $\psi$ has width at most $w$. The exactly-three Tseitin transformation of $\psi$ with parameter $w$ has at most $8(w-2)|\psi|$ clauses, where $|\psi|$ denotes its number of clauses.
hypotheses_covered: The formula is a finite CNF formula
The formula's width is at most $w$
